title: street photo
prompt:
Create a highly realistic editorial street-fashion photograph using the provided reference image for the exact overall composition, environment, lighting, pose, clothing style, flowers, car placement, camera perspective, and visual mood, while using the uploaded face-reference image as the sole identity source for the person.

SUBJECT — EXACT IDENTITY & BODY PRESERVATION

Replace the person in the reference image with the person from the uploaded face-reference photo.

The uploaded person must remain unmistakably the same real person. Identity preservation is the highest priority.

Preserve the uploaded person's:

Exact face shape and facial structure

Forehead, eyebrows, eyes, eyelids and eye shape

Nose shape and proportions

Lips and mouth structure

Cheekbones and jawline

Chin and facial proportions

Natural skin tone and texture

Hairline and naturally visible hairstyle

Facial hair pattern, if present

Natural asymmetry and subtle facial imperfections

Overall recognizable identity

Do not redesign, beautify, feminize, masculinize, age, de-age, or otherwise modify the person's face.

Also preserve the uploaded person's natural body identity and proportions:

Natural height and overall proportions

Shoulder width

Torso and limb proportions

Natural body shape

Natural posture and physical characteristics

Do not make the body unnaturally taller, shorter, thinner, broader, more muscular, curvier, or otherwise different from the uploaded person.

The final image must look like the exact same real person naturally photographed in the reference scene.

GENDER & APPEARANCE

The uploaded person may be male or female.

Automatically preserve the person's actual gender presentation and physical characteristics from the uploaded image. Do not convert a girl into a boy or a boy into a girl.

The reference image should control the scene and styling, not the person's identity.

POSE & EXPRESSION

Recreate the reference pose as closely as possible.

The person should be:

Leaning casually against the side of the white/silver car

Body positioned and angled similarly to the reference

One leg naturally relaxed

Holding the bouquet in front of the torso with both hands

Head positioned and tilted similarly to the reference

Wearing a relaxed, romantic, confident expression

Maintaining natural facial proportions and realistic anatomy

Adapt the pose naturally to the uploaded person's actual body proportions.

Do not distort the body or force an anatomically impossible pose.

CLOTHING — REFERENCE-BASED, BUT NATURALLY ADAPTED

Recreate the same clothing style, color, silhouette, material, and overall appearance shown in the reference image, but adapt it naturally to the uploaded person's gender and body.

The clothing should look realistically fitted to the person's actual body.

If the reference contains the black outfit shown above:

Relaxed all-black outfit

Loose black button-up shirt

Naturally open upper buttons where appropriate

Relaxed black wide-leg trousers

Realistic cotton/linen texture

Natural fabric folds and wrinkles

No logos

No patterns

No unnecessary accessories

The clothing may change, but the person's face, identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and natural physical characteristics must NOT change.

Do not use the reference person's face or body as the identity source.

FLOWERS — EXACTLY MATCH THE REFERENCE

Recreate the bouquet precisely:

Large, dense bouquet

Deep red/crimson roses

Many tightly packed individual roses

Clearly visible realistic petals

Dark green foliage

Natural beige/brown kraft-paper wrapping

Same approximate size and shape as the reference

Held naturally at approximately waist/chest level

Do not replace the roses with other flowers.

BACKGROUND & LOCATION — PRESERVE EXACTLY

Recreate the reference environment as closely as possible.

Use the same visual setting:

European/Parisian-style tree-lined city street

Mature tall trees forming a leafy canopy

Warm sunlight filtering through the leaves

Historic beige/cream stone architecture on the right

Distinctive arched openings/windows

Parked cars lining the street

Urban sidewalk and road

Distant street signs and subtle pedestrians

Natural depth and perspective

Do not replace this with a generic city street, studio, garden, modern street, or unrelated location.

Preserve the same spatial arrangement, perspective, depth, architecture, and environmental character as the reference.

CAR

Include the same visual type of white/silver modern car from the reference.

Preserve:

Car position relative to the person

Visible side mirror

Doors

Windows

Side profile

Perspective

Approximate proportions and placement

No distracting branding, logos, or unrealistic vehicle geometry.

LIGHTING

Match the reference lighting precisely:

Warm nostalgic afternoon sunlight

Soft but clearly visible dappled sunlight through tree leaves

Natural highlights and shadows

Realistic light falling across the person's face, clothing, bouquet, car, and pavement

Gentle atmospheric haze

Warm golden tones

Natural exposure

Subtle cinematic/film-like softness

Lighting must remain physically realistic and consistent throughout the scene.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION

Vertical 9:16 portrait composition.

Use approximately:

Eye/chest-level camera position

Natural smartphone/editorial-camera perspective

Similar framing to the reference

Similar subject placement

Similar car placement

Similar architectural depth

Realistic perspective

Mild natural background softness

The person's face must remain clearly recognizable and naturally detailed.

Do not use excessive artificial bokeh that destroys the background.

PHOTOGRAPHIC REALISM

Create an ultra-realistic candid editorial street photograph.

The final image should contain:

Authentic human skin texture

Natural pores and subtle imperfections

Realistic hair strands

Realistic fabric texture

Physically accurate shadows

Realistic hands and fingers

Natural bouquet details

Accurate reflections on the car

Realistic environmental lighting

Subtle film grain

Slight vintage photographic character

Warm cinematic color grading

The result must look like a genuine photograph captured on a real European street, not an AI-generated image, illustration, CGI render, or digitally composited scene.

CRITICAL IDENTITY RULE

FACE AND BODY IDENTITY > EVERYTHING ELSE.

The uploaded person's face and natural body must remain unchanged.

Use the reference image only for:
scene + background + pose + clothing + bouquet + car + lighting + composition + photographic mood.

Use the uploaded image only for:
person's identity + face + natural body proportions + physical characteristics.

Do not copy the reference person's facial features or body shape onto the uploaded person.
